en.s: The Battle of Munda (17 March 45 BC), in southern Hispania Ulterior, was the final battle of Caesar's civil war against the leaders of the Optimates. With the military victory at Munda and the deaths of Titus Labienus and Gnaeus Pompeius (eldest son of Pompey), Caesar was politically able to return in triumph to Rome, and then govern as the elected Roman dictator.

zh.s: 蒙达之战发生于公元前45年3月17日，地点在西班牙远省南部，是凯撒与贵族派领袖之间内战的最后一场战役。凯撒获胜，提图斯·拉比埃努斯和庞培长子格奈乌斯·庞培战死。凭借这场军事胜利，凯撒得以荣耀地返回罗马，并作为选举产生的独裁官执政。

en.t: Commodus becomes sole emperor of the Roman Empire at the age of eighteen, following the death of his father, Marcus Aurelius
en.s: Commodus (; Latin: [ˈkɔmmɔdʊs]; 31 August 161 – 31 December 192) was Roman emperor from 177 to 192, first serving as nominal co-emperor under his father Marcus Aurelius and then ruling alone from 180. Commodus's sole reign is commonly thought to mark the end of the Pax Romana, a golden age of peace and prosperity in the history of the Roman Empire.

zh.t: 康茂德成为罗马帝国唯一皇帝
zh.s: 公元180年3月17日，皇帝马可·奥勒留去世，18岁的儿子康茂德开始独自统治罗马帝国。他自177年起与父亲名义上共同执政。康茂德的独自统治常被视为“罗马和平”时代的终结。

en.t: Petronius Maximus becomes Western Roman emperor
en.s: Petronius Maximus secured the Western Roman throne on March 17, 455, after the assassination of Valentinian III. He had support in the Roman Senate and won over officials in the imperial palace. After gaining power, he compelled Valentinian's widow, Licinia Eudoxia, to marry him to strengthen his claim.
en.n: The source dates his accession to March 17; it does not give that date for his subsequent marriage.

zh.t: 佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯成为西罗马皇帝
zh.s: 455年3月17日，瓦伦提尼安三世遇刺后，佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在元老院支持下取得西罗马皇位。他还用钱争取宫廷官员。登基后，他强迫前任皇帝的遗孀莉西妮娅·欧多克西娅与自己结婚，以巩固地位。
zh.n: 原文将其统治期起点列为3月17日；婚事没有被单独证明发生在当天。

en.s: The Battle of Olivento was fought on 17 March 1041 between the Byzantine Empire and the Normans of southern Italy and their Lombard allies near the Olivento river, between the actual Basilicata and Apulia, southern Italy.

zh.s: 1041年3月17日，拜占庭帝国与意大利南部的诺曼人及其伦巴第盟友在奥利文托河附近交战，地点位于今意大利南部巴西利卡塔和普利亚之间。

en.s: The Battle of Río Verde was a military engagement between the Granadans and the Castilians at the Río Verde near Marbella. The Granadans achieved a resounding victory.

zh.s: 格拉纳达人与卡斯蒂利亚人在马贝利亚附近的里奥韦尔德交战。格拉纳达人取得了压倒性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Los Alporchones was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista that occurred on 17 March 1452. The battle was fought between the troops of the Emirate of Granada and the combined forces of the Kingdom of Castile and its client kingdom, the Kingdom of Murcia. The Moorish army was commanded by Malik ibn al-Abbas and the Castilian troops were commanded by Alonso Fajardo el Bravo, the head of the House of Fajardo and the Alcalde of Lorca Castle. The battle was fought in the area around the city of Lorca and resulted in a victory for the Kingdom of Castile.

zh.t: 洛斯阿尔波尔乔内斯战役
zh.s: 洛斯阿尔波尔乔内斯战役于1452年3月17日发生，是西班牙收复失地运动中的一场战斗。交战双方是格拉纳达酋长国军队，以及卡斯蒂利亚王国与其附属的穆尔西亚王国联军。摩尔军队由马利克·伊本·阿巴斯指挥，卡斯蒂利亚军队则由法哈多家族首领、洛尔卡城堡长官‘勇者’阿隆索·法哈多指挥。战斗在洛尔卡城周边进行，卡斯蒂利亚王国获胜。

en.s: The Taunton by-election of 1701 to the Parliament of England was held on 17 March 1701 in Taunton, Somerset, following the decision of the incumbent, Henry Portman, to sit in Wells. The by-election was contested by one of Portman's friends, Sir Francis Warre, 1st Baronet, and Thomas Baker, a Taunton merchant. Warre, a Tory, was elected, although Baker petitioned the result, claiming the Mayor was corrupt.

zh.s: 英格兰议会汤顿选区于1701年3月17日在萨默塞特郡汤顿举行补选，原因是现任议员亨利·波特曼选择改任韦尔斯选区议员。参选者为波特曼的朋友、第一代从男爵弗朗西斯·沃尔爵士，以及汤顿商人托马斯·贝克。托利党人沃尔当选，但贝克随后对结果提出申诉，指控市长腐败。

en.s: The Capture of Julfa took place on the night of 16–17 March 1722, during the Siege of Isfahan by forces of Mahmud Hotak. Following his victory at the Battle of Gulnabad, Mahmud concentrated his men against the Armenian suburb of Isfahan, Julfa. Despite being deprived of most of their arms by the Persian authorities, the Armenian townspeople mounted a determined resistance.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1722年3月16日至17日夜间，马哈茂德·霍塔克的军队在围攻伊斯法罕期间攻占朱尔法。此前，他在古尔纳巴德战役中获胜，随后将兵力集中到伊斯法罕的亚美尼亚人聚居区朱尔法。尽管波斯当局收缴了当地居民的大部分武器，亚美尼亚居民仍进行了顽强抵抗。

en.s: The siege of Blair Castle was a conflict that took place in Scotland in March 1746 and was part of the Jacobite rising of 1745. It was fought between Scottish forces loyal to the British-Hanoverian government of George II of Great Britain, which defended Blair Castle near the village of Blair Atholl in Perthshire, and Scottish Jacobite forces loyal to the House of Stuart.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 布莱尔城堡围城战于1746年3月在苏格兰发生，是1745年詹姆斯党起义的一部分。交战双方是效忠英国国王乔治二世及汉诺威王朝政府的苏格兰军队，与效忠斯图亚特王朝的苏格兰詹姆斯党军队。前者守卫珀斯郡布莱尔阿瑟尔村附近的布莱尔城堡。

en.s: The Atholl raids of 14 - 17 March 1746 were a series of raids carried out by Jacobite rebels against the British-Hanoverian Government during the Jacobite rising of 1745.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1746年3月14日至17日，詹姆斯党叛军在苏格兰发动了一系列突袭，攻击效忠英国和汉诺威政府的目标。

en.t: American Revolutionary War: The 11‑month Siege of Boston ended with the evacuation of the city's British garrison (depicted)
en.s: The siege of Boston (April 19, 1775 – March 17, 1776) was the opening phase of the American Revolutionary War. In the siege, American patriot militia led by newly-installed Continental Army commander George Washington prevented the British Army, which was garrisoned in Boston, from moving by land. Both sides faced resource, supply, and personnel challenges during the siege.

zh.t: 美国独立战争：波士顿围城战结束，英军撤离该城
zh.s: 波士顿围城战（1775年4月19日至1776年3月17日）是美国独立战争的开端阶段。围城期间，由新任大陆军总司令乔治·华盛顿领导的美国爱国者民兵阻止驻扎在波士顿的英军从陆路离开。围城双方都面临资源、补给和人员方面的困难。

en.s: The raid on Baltischport occurred on 17 March 1790 during the Russo-Swedish War of 1788–1790. Two Swedish Navy frigates under Lieutenant Rudolf Cederström successfully raided the Russian-controlled port of Baltischport in the Governorate of Estonia. Leading a naval brigade of between 50 and 60 men, Cederström forced the surrender of a Russian fort after a short bombardment despite being heavily outnumbered by the fort's garrison.

zh.s: 1790年3月17日，1788至1790年俄瑞战争期间，瑞典海军中尉鲁道夫·塞德斯特伦指挥两艘护卫舰，成功突袭俄国控制的爱沙尼亚省巴尔蒂施港。他率领一支50至60人的海军登陆部队，虽然人数远少于俄军堡垒守军，仍在短暂炮击后迫使对方投降。

en.s: The First Battle of Chantonnay took place on March 17, 1793, during the War in the Vendée, a counter-revolutionary uprising against the French First Republic.

zh.s: 第一次尚托奈战役于1793年3月17日旺代战争期间发生。旺代战争是一场反对法兰西第一共和国的反革命起义。

en.s: The Battle of Villafranca del Bierzo took place on 17 March 1809, during the French occupation of León in the Peninsular War. After a bloody four-hour siege the small and isolated French garrison at Villafranca surrendered to Spanish regulars under Brigadier José de Mendizábal and General Pedro Caro, 3rd Marquis of la Romana.

zh.s: 1809年3月17日，半岛战争中法军占领莱昂期间，比利亚弗兰卡-德尔比埃尔索爆发战斗。经过四小时血战围攻，孤立无援的小股法军守军，向何塞·德·门迪萨瓦尔准将和第三代拉罗马纳侯爵佩德罗·卡罗将军率领的西班牙正规军投降。

en.s: The combat of Mesas de Ibor (17 March 1809) was a French victory during the Peninsular War at which the Spanish troops under General Duke del Parque were defeated by Leval's division, made up of German battalions.

zh.s: 梅萨斯德伊沃尔战斗发生于1809年3月17日，是半岛战争期间法国的一场胜利。勒瓦尔师击败了德尔帕尔克公爵率领的西班牙军队，该师由德国营组成。

en.s: The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824, also known as the Treaty of London (Dutch: Verdrag van Londen), was a treaty between the United Kingdom and the Netherlands in London on 17 March 1824. The treaty was to resolve disputes arising from the execution of the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814. For the Dutch, it was signed by Hendrik Fagel and Anton Reinhard Falck, and for the British, George Canning and Charles Williams-Wynn.

zh.s: 《1824年英荷条约》又称《伦敦条约》，由英国与荷兰于1824年3月17日在伦敦签订，旨在解决执行《1814年英荷条约》所产生的争议。荷兰方面由亨德里克·法赫尔和安东·莱因哈德·法尔克签字，英国方面由乔治·坎宁和查尔斯·威廉斯-温签字。

en.s: The First Taranaki War (also known as the North Taranaki War) was an armed conflict over land ownership and sovereignty that took place between Māori and the Colony of New Zealand in the Taranaki region of New Zealand's North Island from March 1860 to March 1861. The war was sparked by a dispute between the colonial government and the Te Āti Awa people, led by Wiremu Kīngi Te Rangitāke, over the disputed sale of the Pekapeka land block at Waitara.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次塔拉纳基战争又称北塔拉纳基战争，是毛利人和新西兰殖民地之间围绕土地所有权与主权发生的武装冲突。战争于1860年3月至1861年3月在新西兰北岛塔拉纳基地区持续。冲突起因是殖民政府与特阿蒂阿瓦人之间对怀塔拉佩卡佩卡土地出售的争议，后者由维雷穆·金吉·特朗吉塔克领导。

en.t: The first railway line of Finland between cities of Helsinki and Hämeenlinna, called Päärata, is officially opened
en.s: The Finnish railway network consists of a total track length of 9,216 km (5,727 mi). Railways in Finland are built with a broad 1,524 mm (5 ft) track gauge, of which 3,249 km (2,019 mi) is electrified. Passenger trains are operated by the state-owned enterprise VR that runs services on 7,225 km (4,489 mi) of track.

zh.t: 芬兰首条铁路干线“主干线”正式通车，连接赫尔辛基与海门林纳
zh.s: 芬兰铁路网的轨道总长为9,216公里（5,727英里）。芬兰铁路采用宽轨，轨距为1,524毫米（5英尺），其中3,249公里（2,019英里）已实现电气化。客运列车由国有企业VR运营，该公司在7,225公里（4,489英里）的线路上提供服务。

en.s: The Battle of Kelly's Ford, also known as the Battle of Kellysville or Kelleysville, took place on March 17, 1863, in Culpeper County, Virginia, as part of the cavalry operations along the Rappahannock River during the American Civil War. It set the stage for Brandy Station and other cavalry actions of the Gettysburg Campaign that summer. Twenty-one hundred troopers of Brig. Gen. William W. Averell's Union cavalry division crossed the Rappahannock to attack the Confederate cavalry that had been harassing them that winter. Brig. Gen. Fitzhugh Lee counterattacked with a brigade of about 800 men.

zh.s: 凯利渡口战役又称凯利斯维尔战役，于1863年3月17日在弗吉尼亚州卡尔佩珀县发生，是美国内战中沿拉帕汉诺克河骑兵作战的一部分，也为当年夏季葛底斯堡战役中的布兰迪站及其他骑兵战斗铺平道路。威廉·W.阿弗里尔准将的北军骑兵师派出2,100人渡过拉帕汉诺克河，进攻整个冬季不断骚扰他们的南军骑兵。菲茨休·李准将率约800人的一个旅反击。

en.s: On March 17, 1863, Captain John Singleton Mosby, nicknamed "The Gray Ghost", raided a Union outpost at Herndon Station in Northern Virginia. The raid was a part of a series of such raids coordinated by Captain Mosby and his raiders in 1863 in areas of Northern Virginia. The raid on Herndon Station was the furthest north into Union lines Mosby and his men ventured.

zh.t: 莫斯比突袭赫恩登车站
zh.s: 1863年3月17日，绰号“灰色幽灵”的约翰·辛格尔顿·莫斯比上尉突袭了弗吉尼亚州北部赫恩登车站的一处联邦军前哨。这是莫斯比及其突袭队1863年在弗吉尼亚州北部多次突袭行动之一，也是他们深入联邦军防线最北的一次。

en.s: The naval Battle of Jasmund (also known as the Battle of Rügen) took place between elements of the Danish and Prussian navies on 17 March 1864 during the Second Schleswig War. The action took place east of the Jasmund peninsula on the Prussian island of Rügen, during a Prussian attempt to weaken the Danish blockade in the Baltic Sea.

zh.s: 第二次石勒苏益格战争期间，丹麦和普鲁士海军于1864年3月17日在吕根岛亚斯蒙德半岛以东交战。这场战斗也称吕根海战，发生在普鲁士试图削弱丹麦对波罗的海封锁期间。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 10 March 1867, with a second round on 17 March. Before the elections, Bettino Ricasoli resigned as prime minister due to a disagreement with the Chamber; the Chamber disapproved of his agreements with the Vatican regarding the repatriation of certain religious properties. These snap elections resulted in Urbano Rattazzi being elected once again to office.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 意大利于1867年3月10日举行大选，第二轮投票于3月17日进行。选前，贝蒂诺·里卡索利因与众议院发生分歧而辞去首相职务。众议院不赞成他与梵蒂冈就归还部分宗教财产达成的协议。这次提前举行的选举使乌尔巴诺·拉塔齐再次执政。

en.s: The Battle of Powder River, also known as the Reynolds Battle, occurred on Friday, March 17, 1876, in Montana Territory, United States. The attack on a Cheyenne Indian encampment by Colonel Joseph J. Reynolds initiated the Great Sioux War of 1876. Although destroying a large amount of Indian property, the attack was poorly carried out and probably solidified Lakota Sioux and northern Cheyenne resistance to the U.S. attempt to force them to sell the Black Hills and live on a reservation.

zh.s: 波德河战役又称雷诺兹战役，于1876年3月17日星期五在美国蒙大拿领地发生。约瑟夫·J.雷诺兹上校袭击一处夏延人营地，开启了1876年的大苏族战争。虽然摧毁了大量原住民财物，但袭击执行不力，可能反而加强了拉科塔苏族与北夏延人的抵抗。他们反对美国迫使其出售黑山并迁入保留地的企图。

en.s: The 1877 Scottish Cup final was the fourth final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1876–77 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The original match took place at Hamilton Crescent on 17 March 1877 and was contested by Vale of Leven and Rangers. The match was the first final to require two replays to decide a winner.

zh.s: 1877年苏格兰杯决赛是该项赛事的第4届决赛，也是1876—77赛季、苏格兰最负盛名的淘汰制足球赛事的最后一轮。最初的比赛于1877年3月17日在汉密尔顿新月球场举行，由利文谷对阵流浪者。这是首次需要两次重赛才能决定冠军的决赛。

en.t: Rupture of the Blockade of Arica
en.s: The Rupture of the Blockade of Arica was a naval battle of the War of the Pacific during the Blockade of Arica. The rupture was carried out by Manuel Villavicencio who commanded the BAP Unión of the Peruvian Navy. The Unión broke the Chilean blockade of the port twice in less than 8 hours on March 17, 1880.

zh.s: 突破阿里卡封锁是太平洋战争阿里卡封锁期间的一次海上行动。1880年3月17日，秘鲁海军‘联合’号在曼努埃尔·比利亚维森西奥指挥下，于不到八小时内两次突破智利对该港的封锁。

en.t: The Qing government appointed the Assistant Minister to Tibet, Sheng Tai, to travel to Calcutta, India, on March 17, 1890, where he signed the convention with Lord Lansdowne
en.s: The Convention of Calcutta or Anglo-Chinese Convention of 1890, officially the Convention Between Great Britain and China Relating to Sikkim and Tibet, (Chinese: 中英藏印條約; pinyin: Zhōng yīng zàng yìn tiáoyuē; lit. 'Convention Between Great Britain and China Regarding Tibet and India') was a treaty between Britain and Qing China relating to Tibet and the Kingdom of Sikkim.

zh.t: 清政府任命盛泰赴印度加尔各答，并与兰斯当签署条约
zh.s: 《加尔各答公约》又称1890年《英中公约》，正式名称为《大不列颠与中国关于锡金和西藏的公约》（中文名：《中英藏印条约》），是英国与清朝签署的一项涉及西藏和锡金王国的条约。

en.s: The Rye by-election, 1903 was a by-election held in England on 17 March 1903 for the House of Commons constituency of the Rye or Eastern Division of Sussex.

zh.s: 1903年3月17日，英格兰举行赖伊选区、又称萨塞克斯东分区的英国下议院议员补选。

en.s: The Bir Hakeim rescue (Arabic: بئر حكيم, romanized: biʾr ḥakīm, lit. 'Wise Well' pronounced [biʔr ħaˈkiːm] ) was a British raid in Italian Cyrenaica (modern Libya) on 17 March 1916 to recover prisoners of war held by the Senussi. Following the capture of Sollum on 14 March the British discovered evidence that the prisoners, survivors from two ships sunk by a German U-boat, were being held at the Bir Hakeim oasis, about 99 mi (160 km) to the west.

zh.s: 比尔哈基姆营救行动（阿拉伯语：بئر حكيم，意为“智者之井”）是英国于1916年3月17日在意属昔兰尼加（今利比亚）发动的一次突袭，目的是救回被塞努西教团扣押的战俘。3月14日攻占索卢姆后，英军发现线索，得知两艘被德国潜艇击沉的船上有幸存者被关押在比尔哈基姆绿洲，那里位于以西约99英里（160公里）处。

en.s: The action of 17 March 1917 was a German raid on British shipping in the Strait of Dover as well as the harbours of Ramsgate and Margate. Two flotillas of German torpedo boats set out from the coast of Flanders and split. One group attacked the British drifters and destroyers patrolling near Goodwin Sands, while the other attacked the towns of Ramsgate and Margate, shelling the towns and shipping in their harbors.

zh.s: 1917年3月17日，德国军队袭击了多佛海峡的英国船只，以及拉姆斯盖特和马盖特两处港口。两支德国鱼雷艇舰队从佛兰德斯海岸出发后分头行动：一支袭击古德温沙滩附近巡逻的英国渔船和驱逐舰，另一支炮击拉姆斯盖特、马盖特两镇及港内船只。

en.s: The Battle of Charah (12–17 March 1918) or Charah Expedition took place between the Assyrian Volunteers led by Agha Petros and Malik Khsoshaba against Shekak tribesmen led by Simko Shikak in revenge for the assassination of Mar Benyamin Shimun. Simko Shikak, who was responsible for the murder of the Assyrian patriarch Mar Shimun was staying in the fortress. The fortress had never been conquered despite numerous attempts by the Iranian government.

zh.s: 查拉赫战役又称查拉赫远征，发生于1918年3月12日至17日。阿加·彼得罗斯和马利克·赫绍沙巴领导的亚述志愿军，与希卡克部族成员交战；后者由西姆科·希卡克率领。此次行动是为报复本杰明·西门大牧首遇刺。西姆科·希卡克当时驻守在堡垒中，他曾参与杀害西门大牧首。尽管伊朗政府多次试图攻占，这座堡垒此前从未失守。

en.s: The Second Polish Republic adopted the March Constitution on 17 March 1921, after ousting the occupation of the German/Prussian forces in the 1918 Greater Poland Uprising, and avoiding conquest by the Soviets in the 1920 Polish-Soviet War. The Constitution, based on the Constitution of the Third French Republic, was regarded as very democratic. Among others, it expressly ruled out discrimination on racial or religious grounds.

zh.s: 波兰第二共和国于1921年3月17日通过《三月宪法》。此前，波兰在1918年大波兰起义中摆脱德国和普鲁士军队的占领，并在1920年波苏战争中避免被苏联征服。该宪法以法兰西第三共和国宪法为蓝本，被认为相当民主，其中明确禁止基于种族或宗教的歧视。

en.s: The Soviet invasion of Georgia (12 February – 17 March 1921), also known as the Georgian–Soviet War or the Red Army invasion of Georgia, was a military campaign by the Russian Soviet Red Army aimed at overthrowing the Social Democratic (Menshevik) government of the Democratic Republic of Georgia (DRG) and installing a Bolshevik regime (Communist Party of Georgia) in the country.

zh.s: 苏联入侵格鲁吉亚（1921年2月12日至3月17日）又称格鲁吉亚—苏联战争或红军入侵格鲁吉亚，是俄罗斯苏维埃红军发动的一场军事行动，旨在推翻格鲁吉亚民主共和国的社会民主党（孟什维克）政府，并在当地建立布尔什维克政权（格鲁吉亚共产党）。

en.s: The Battle of Nanchang (simplified Chinese: 南昌会战; traditional Chinese: 南昌會戰) was a military campaign fought in 1939 around Nanchang, Jiangxi between the Chinese National Revolutionary Army and the Japanese Imperial Japanese Army in the Second Sino-Japanese War. It was the first major conflict after the 1938 Battle of Wuhan.

en.s: The Treaty of Brussels, also referred to as the Brussels Pact, was the founding treaty of the Western Union (WU) between 1948 and 1954, when it was amended as the Modified Brussels Treaty (MTB) and served as the founding treaty of the Western European Union (WEU) until its termination in 2010. The treaty provided for the organisation of military, economic, social and cultural cooperation among member states as well as a mutual defence clause. The treaty was signed on 17 March 1948 by Belgium, France, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom, the members of the Western Union, as an expansion to the Treaty of Dunkirk, which had been signed between Britain and France the previous year to guard against possible German or Soviet aggression after the end of World War II.

zh.s: 布鲁塞尔条约又称《布鲁塞尔公约》，是西方联盟（WU）的创始条约，1948年至1954年间有效。1954年条约修订后，成为西欧联盟（WEU）的创始条约，直至该组织于2010年终止。条约规定成员国在军事、经济、社会和文化领域开展合作，并包含共同防御条款。1948年3月17日，比利时、法国、卢森堡、荷兰和英国签署条约，成立西方联盟。这是在前一年英法签署的《敦刻尔克条约》基础上的扩展，旨在二战结束后防范德国或苏联可能的侵略。

en.t: Researchers at the University of California, Berkeley announce the creation of element 98, which they name "californium"
en.s: The University of California, Berkeley (UC Berkeley, Berkeley, Cal, or California) is a public land-grant research university in Berkeley, California, United States. Founded in 1868 and named after the Anglo-Irish philosopher and plantation owner George Berkeley, it is the state's first land-grant university and the founding campus of the University of California system. Berkeley has an enrollment of more than 45,000 students.

zh.t: 加州大学伯克利分校研究人员宣布发现第98号元素，并将其命名为“锎”
zh.s: 加州大学伯克利分校（UC Berkeley，也称Berkeley、Cal或California）是位于美国加利福尼亚州伯克利市的一所公立赠地研究型大学。学校创立于1868年，名称取自英裔爱尔兰哲学家兼种植园主乔治·贝克莱。它是加州第一所赠地大学，也是加州大学系统的创始校区，在校生超过45,000人。

en.s: The 1957 crash of a Douglas C-47 plane named "Mt. Pinatubo" on the slopes of Mount Manunggal, Cebu, Philippines, killed the 7th President of the Philippines, Ramon Magsaysay, and 24 other passengers. The crash is estimated to have occurred at 1:40:00 AM, March 17, 1957, Philippine Standard Time (17:40:00 PM, March 16, 1957, GMT). Several high-ranking Philippine government and military officials, as well as journalists, were also among the dead. A reporter for the Philippine Herald, Nestor Mata, was the sole survivor of the accident. At the time of his death, President Magsaysay, a Nacionalista, was widely popular and was expected to easily win re-election in the November presidential elections.

zh.s: 1957年3月17日，一架名为‘皮纳图博山’号的道格拉斯C-47飞机，在菲律宾宿务的马农加尔山坡坠毁，造成菲律宾第7任总统拉蒙·麦格赛赛及另外24名乘客死亡。事故估计发生在菲律宾标准时间凌晨1时40分，即格林尼治时间3月16日17时40分。死者还包括多名菲律宾政府和军方高级官员及记者。《菲律宾先驱报》记者内斯托尔·马塔是唯一幸存者。国民党籍的麦格赛赛总统当时广受欢迎，原本预计会在11月总统选举中轻松连任。

en.t: The United States launches the first solar-powered satellite, which is also the first satellite to achieve a long-term orbit
en.s: Vanguard 1 (Harvard designation: 1958-Beta 2, COSPAR ID: 1958-002B) is an American satellite that was the fourth artificial Earth-orbiting satellite to be successfully launched, following Sputnik 1, Sputnik 2, and Explorer 1. It was launched 17 March 1958. Vanguard 1 was the first satellite to have solar electric power. Although communications with the satellite were lost in 1964, it remains the oldest artificial object still in orbit, together with the upper stage of its launch vehicle.

zh.t: 美国发射首颗太阳能卫星，并实现首个长期轨道运行
zh.s: 先锋1号（哈佛编号：1958-Beta 2；COSPAR编号：1958-002B）是美国卫星，也是继“斯普特尼克1号”“斯普特尼克2号”和“探险者1号”之后，成功发射的第四颗绕地人造卫星。它于1958年3月17日发射，是首颗使用太阳能供电的卫星。与其发射火箭的上面级一道，它至今仍是留在轨道上的最古老人造物体。卫星于1964年失去通信。

en.s: Northwest Orient Airlines Flight 710, a Lockheed L-188 Electra, disintegrated in-flight and crashed near Cannelton, Indiana (10 miles east of Tell City, Indiana) on March 17, 1960. The flight carried 57 passengers and 6 crew members. There were no survivors.

zh.s: 1960年3月17日，西北东方航空710号航班执飞的一架洛克希德L-188‘伊莱克特拉’客机在空中解体，坠毁于印第安纳州坎内尔顿附近、特尔城以东10英里处。机上57名乘客和6名机组人员全部遇难。

en.t: An eruption of Mount Agung on Bali, Indonesia, killed at least 1,100 people
en.s: Mount Agung (Indonesian: Gunung Agung; Balinese: ᬕᬸᬦᬸᬂᬆᬕᬸᬂ, romanized: gunung āgung, lit. 'The Great Mountain') is an active volcano in Karangasem Regency, Bali, Indonesia. It is located southeast of Mount Batur volcano, also in Bali. It is the highest point on Bali, and dominates the surrounding area, influencing the climate, especially rainfall patterns. From a distance, the mountain appears to be perfectly conical.

zh.t: 印度尼西亚巴厘岛阿贡火山喷发，造成至少1,100人死亡
zh.s: 阿贡火山（印度尼西亚语：Gunung Agung；巴厘语：ᬕᬸᬦᬸᬂᬆᬕᬸᬂ，转写：gunung āgung，意为“大山”）是一座活火山，位于印度尼西亚巴厘岛卡朗阿森县。它位于同在巴厘岛的巴杜尔火山东南方，是巴厘岛最高点，主宰着周边地区，并影响当地气候，尤其是降雨模式。从远处看，这座山呈现出近乎完美的圆锥形。

en.s: Operation Walker was a security operation conducted during the Vietnam War by the U.S. Army's 1st Battalion, 503rd Infantry Regiment, 173rd Airborne Brigade in Bình Định Province, South Vietnam from 17 March 1968 to 31 January 1969.

zh.s: ‘沃克行动’是越南战争期间，美军第173空降旅第503步兵团第1营于1968年3月17日至1969年1月31日，在南越平定省进行的安全行动。

en.s: Golda Meir (previously Meyerson; née Mabovitch; 3 May 1898 – 8 December 1978) served as the prime minister of Israel from 1969 to 1974. She was Israel's first and, to date, only female head of government. Born into a Ukrainian-Jewish family in Kiev, Russian Empire, Meir immigrated with her family to the United States in 1906, later graduating from the Milwaukee State Normal School and found work as a teacher.

A distracting attack was launched from Boumalong in the north while the main assault struck northwards from Ban Pa Dong.

en.t: Slava Veder took his Pulitzer Prize-winning photograph Burst of Joy, which came to symbolize the end of United States involvement in the Vietnam War
en.s: Burst of Joy is a Pulitzer Prize–winning photograph showing Robert L. Stirm (1933–2025), a lieutenant colonel in the United States Air Force, meeting his family after five years as a POW in North Vietnam due to the Vietnam War. The photograph was taken by Slava "Sal" Veder, an Associated Press photographer, on March 17, 1973, at Travis Air Force Base in Solano County, California.

zh.t: 斯拉瓦·韦德拍摄《喜悦时刻》，这张普利策奖获奖照片成为美国结束越战的象征

en.s: The Gilbert Islands held its first national election to choose a chief minister on 17 March 1978. Opposition leader Ieremia Tabai won with 55.6% of the vote, following a voter turnout of 73.5%. The election for chief minister came after the parliamentary election of the same year and the new parliament's unanimous vote to replace the appointed chief minister with one that was popularly elected.

zh.t: 1978年吉尔伯特群岛首席部长选举
zh.s: 1978年3月17日，吉尔伯特群岛举行首次全国选举，选出首席部长。反对党领袖耶雷米亚·塔拜以55.6%的得票率获胜，投票率为73.5%。当年议会选举结束后，新议会一致决定废除任命制首席部长，改由民选产生。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 1691 crashed near Moscow Vnukovo Airport on 17 March 1979 killing 58 of the 119 people on board. The Tupolev Tu-104B operating the flight was overloaded and the crew received a false fire alarm.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空1691号班机空难
zh.s: 1979年3月17日，俄罗斯航空1691号班机在莫斯科伏努科沃机场附近坠毁，机上119人中有58人遇难。涉事图-104B客机超载，机组人员还收到错误的火警警报。

en.s: The 1979 Football League Cup final took place on 17 March 1979 at Wembley Stadium. It was the nineteenth Football League Cup final and the thirteenth to be played at Wembley. It was contested between Nottingham Forest and Southampton. Forest were the hot favourites to win being the holders of the League Cup and the reigning First Division champions. The match finished 3–2 to Forest.

zh.s: 1979年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于3月17日在温布利球场举行。这是第19届联赛杯决赛，也是第13次在温布利举行。诺丁汉森林对阵南安普敦。作为卫冕联赛杯冠军和当时的英格兰顶级联赛冠军，森林队是赛前热门。最终，森林队以3比2获胜。

en.s: The 1981 Season's Cup became the second edition of Season's Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Soviet Top League and Soviet Cup competitions. The match was played at the Stadion Lokomotiv, Simferopol, on 17 March 1981, and contested by league winner Dinamo Kiev and cup winner Shakhter Donetsk. Shakhter Donetsk won it on penalty shootout.

zh.s: 1981年苏联赛季杯是该赛事第2届比赛，由上赛季苏联顶级联赛冠军与苏联杯冠军进行年度对决。比赛于1981年3月17日在辛菲罗波尔的火车头体育场举行，由联赛冠军基辅迪纳摩对阵杯赛冠军顿涅茨克矿工。矿工队在点球大战中获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 17 March 1985. The Front of Socialist Unity and Democracy (FDUS), dominated by the Romanian Communist Party (PCR) and including other mass organisations, was the only group to contest the elections, and no prospective candidate could run for office without the Front's approval. Consequently, FDUS candidates won all 369 seats in the Great National Assembly, also ensuring the rubber-stamp confirmation of Nicolae Ceaușescu as President of Romania.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于1985年3月17日举行议会选举。由罗马尼亚共产党主导、包含其他群众组织的社会主义民主和团结阵线，是唯一参选团体，任何候选人都须先获其批准才能参选。因此，该阵线候选人赢得大国民议会全部369席，也确保尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库的总统职位得以形式上确认。

en.t: 1987 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final
en.s: The 1987 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Croke Park on 17 March 1987 to determine the winners of the 1986–87 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, the 17th season of the All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion clubs of the four provinces of Ireland.

en.s: The 1990 Recopa Sudamericana was the second Recopa Sudamericana, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Copa Libertadores and Supercopa Sudamericana competitions. en.s: The 1995 Azerbaijani coup d'état attempt, also known as the Turkish coup in Baku, was a coup d'état attempt by members of the Azerbaijani military, led by Colonel Rovshan Javadov at the head of a detachment of Special Purpose Police Unit (OPON). The group aimed to take control of the country from president Heydar Aliyev and reinstall former president Abulfaz Elchibey. The coup was foiled when the Turkish President Süleyman Demirel became aware of elements in Turkey supporting the plot, and called Aliyev to warn him. On 17 March 1995, units of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces surrounded the insurgents' camp and assaulted it, killing Colonel Javadov.

en.s: General elections were held in Sudan to elect a President and National Assembly between 2 and 17 March 1996. They were the first elections since 1986 due to a military coup in 1989, and the first simultaneous elections for the presidency and National Assembly. 125 members of the 400-seat National Assembly had been nominated before the election, leaving 275 seats to be elected (of which 51 were ultimately uncontested). There were no political parties at the time, and all candidates ran as independents. In the presidential election, 40 candidates ran against incumbent Omar al-Bashir, who emerged victorious with 75.4% of the vote.

zh.s: 苏丹于1996年3月2日至17日举行总统和国民议会选举。这是1989年军事政变以来、也是自1986年以来首次举行选举，亦是首次同时选举总统和国民议会。400席的国民议会中，125名议员已于投票前获任命，其余275席由选举产生，其中51席最终没有竞争。当时国内没有政党，所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选。在总统选举中，40名候选人挑战现任总统奥马尔·巴希尔，后者以75.4%的得票率获胜。

en.s: Presidential elections was held in Zimbabwe on 16 and 17 March 1996. en.s: WrestleMania X8 was the eighteenth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on March 17, 2002, at the SkyDome in Toronto, the second WrestleMania at that venue (following WrestleMania VI in 1990). The event marked the final WrestleMania event under the WWF name. The record-breaking attendance for the SkyDome of 68,237 grossed approximately $6.1 million CAD ($3.9 million USD). WrestleMania weekend also included WWF Fan Axxess at the Canadian National Exhibition's Automotive Building. The main event was between Chris Jericho and Triple H for the Undisputed WWF Championship, which Triple H won after a Pedigree.

en.s: The 2013 Scottish League Cup final was the 67th final of the Scottish League Cup. The final took place on 17 March 2013 at Hampden Park, Glasgow. The clubs contesting the 2013 final were SPL clubs, St Mirren and Hearts. As Hearts finished in the top five of the SPL, they entered the League Cup in the third round. They made a convincing start, defeating Livingston in third round.

zh.s: 2013年苏格兰联赛杯决赛是该赛事第67届决赛，于3月17日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，由苏超俱乐部圣米伦与哈茨交锋。哈茨因上赛季跻身苏超前五名，从联赛杯第三轮开始参赛，并在首战中击败利文斯顿，取得有说服力的开局。

en.s: The Quebec Liberal Party held a leadership convention in 2013 following Jean Charest's resignation after the party's 2012 election loss. The convention was held March 16–17, 2013, at the Verdun Auditorium in Montreal. The choice of venue was in part influenced by a lack of funds due to a recent drop in donations to the party. Philippe Couillard was elected on the first ballot.

zh.s: 魁北克自由党于2013年举行领袖大会，选出让·夏雷辞职后的继任者。夏雷在该党于2012年选举失利后辞去党魁职务。领袖大会于2013年3月16日至17日在蒙特利尔的韦尔登礼堂举行。由于该党近期捐款减少、资金不足，场地选择也受到影响。菲利普·库亚尔在首轮投票中当选。

en.s: The March 2017 Israel–Syria incident took place on 17 March 2017, when Israeli Air Force struck a target in Syria. In response the Syrian Army fired several S-200 missiles at Israeli jets above Golan Heights. Israel reported that one Syrian missile had been shot down by an Arrow 2 missile, while none of its aircraft had been damaged.

zh.t: 2017年3月以色列与叙利亚交火事件
zh.s: 2017年3月17日，以色列空军打击叙利亚境内一处目标，引发以叙交火。叙利亚军队向戈兰高地上空的以色列军机发射多枚S-200导弹。以色列称，其中一枚叙利亚导弹被‘箭-2’导弹击落，己方飞机均未受损。

en.s: Homenaje a Dos Leyendas (2017) (Spanish for "Homage to Two Legends") was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event, scripted and produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council"). The Dos Leyendas show took place on March 17, 2017 in CMLL's main venue, Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The event was to honor and remember CMLL founder Salvador Lutteroth, who died in March 1987.

zh.s: 2017年‘致敬两位传奇’是世界摔角理事会（CMLL）编排并制作的按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月17日在其主场、墨西哥墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，旨在纪念于1987年3月去世的CMLL创始人萨尔瓦多·卢特罗特。

en.s: A by-election for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Batman in Melbourne, Victoria, took place on 17 March 2018. The by-election was called as a result of the resignation on 1 February 2018 of the incumbent backbench Australian Labor Party (ALP) Member of Parliament (MP) David Feeney, who resigned amid the 2017–18 Australian parliamentary eligibility crisis.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院位于维多利亚州墨尔本的巴特曼选区，于2018年3月17日举行补选。现任工党后座议员戴维·菲尼于2月1日，在2017至2018年澳大利亚国会议员资格危机期间辞职，因此须补选其席位。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Werdum vs. Volkov
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Werdum vs. Volkov (also known as UFC Fight Night 127) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on March 17, 2018, at The O2 Arena in London, England.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：温顿对沃尔科夫
zh.s: ‘UFC格斗之夜：温顿对沃尔科夫’又称‘UFC格斗之夜127’，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2018年3月17日在英格兰伦敦O2竞技场举行。

en.s: A by-election for the electoral district of Cottesloe in Western Australia took place on 17 March 2018. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of the Liberal Party member, Colin Barnett, on 5 February 2018. Barnett was the Premier of Western Australia from 23 September 2008 until 17 March 2017, when he was succeeded as Premier by Mark McGowan after the Labor Party defeated Barnett's Liberal government at the 2017 state election in March 2017.

zh.t: 2018年科特斯洛选区州议会补选
zh.s: 澳大利亚西澳大利亚州科特斯洛选区于2018年3月17日举行补选。此次补选由自由党议员科林·巴内特于2018年2月5日辞职引发。巴内特曾于2008年9月23日至2017年3月17日担任西澳大利亚州州长；2017年3月，工党在州选举中击败巴内特领导的自由党政府后，马克·麦高恩接任州长。

en.s: The 2018 Indian Super League final was a football match between Bengaluru and Chennaiyin, played on 17 March 2018, at the Sree Kanteerava Stadium in Bangalore. The match was a culmination of the 2017–18 Indian Super League, the fourth season of one of the top professional football leagues in India. Chennaiyin won the match, defeating Bengaluru 3–2.

zh.s: 2018年印度超级联赛决赛于3月17日在班加罗尔的斯里坎蒂拉瓦体育场举行，由班加罗尔队对阵钦奈因队。这场比赛是2017至2018赛季印度超级联赛的收官战，也是印度顶级职业足球联赛的第四个赛季。钦奈因队以3比2击败班加罗尔队，赢得冠军。

en.s: The 2018 Belgian Cup final, named Croky Cup after the sponsor, was the 63rd Belgian Cup final and took place on 17 March 2018. The match was played between Genk, who qualified on 6 February 2018, and Standard Liège who qualified two days later. In a dull match without many chances, Standard Liège won after extra time with the only goal coming from Renaud Emond at the beginning of extra time.

zh.s: 2018年比利时杯决赛又称克罗基杯（以赞助商命名），是第63届比利时杯决赛，于3月17日举行。亨克队和标准列日队在比赛中相遇，前者于2月6日晋级，后者两天后晋级。比赛机会不多，标准列日队在加时赛中凭雷诺·埃蒙德开场不久打进的全场唯一进球获胜。

en.s: The 2018 South Australian state election to elect members to the 54th Parliament of South Australia was held on 17 March 2018. All 47 seats in the House of Assembly or lower house, whose members were elected at the 2014 election, and 11 of 22 seats in the Legislative Council or upper house, last filled at the 2010 election, were contested.

zh.s: 2018年3月17日，南澳大利亚举行选举，选出第54届州议会议员。众议院（下议院）47席全部改选，这些议员上次是在2014年选出；立法会（上议院）22席中的11席也参与改选，这些席位上次于2010年改选。

en.t: Results of the 2018 South Australian state election (Legislative Council)
en.s: This is a list of results for the Legislative Council at the 2018 South Australian state election. The 11 of 22 seats up for election were 4 Liberal, 4 Labor, 1 Green, 1 Conservative and 1 Dignity. The outcome was 4 Liberal, 4 Labor, 2 SA Best and 1 Green.

zh.t: 2018年南澳大利亚州选举结果（立法会）
zh.s: 这是2018年南澳大利亚州选举立法会席位的结果列表。22个席位中有11席改选，其中自由党4席、工党4席、绿党1席、保守党1席、尊严党1席。最终，自由党获得4席、工党4席、SA Best党2席、绿党1席。

en.s: The raid on Dioura was an attack on a Malian military base in the town of Dioura, Mali, by Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) on March 17, 2019.

en.s: The 2019 Indian Super League final was the final match of the 2018–19 Indian Super League, the fifth season of the Indian Super League. It was played between Bengaluru FC and FC Goa, on 17 March 2019 at the Mumbai Football Arena, Mumbai. It was played to determine the champions of the 2018–19 season of the Indian Super League.

zh.s: 2019年印度超级联赛决赛是2018—19赛季、即该联赛第5个赛季的最后一场比赛。班加罗尔与果阿FC于2019年3月17日在孟买足球竞技场交锋，争夺该赛季冠军。

en.s: Clearwater, Florida, held a general election on March 17, 2020, to elect a mayor and two members of the city council (seat 2 and 3). These elections coincided with the Democratic and Republican presidential preference primaries.

zh.t: 2020年佛罗里达州克利尔沃特市政选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州克利尔沃特于2020年3月17日举行选举，选出市长及第2、第3席两名市议员，与民主党和共和党总统候选人偏好初选同日进行。

en.s: The 2020 Illinois Democratic presidential primary took place on March 17, 2020, the third primary Tuesday of the month, as one of three states voting on the same day in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election, while the contest in Ohio had been postponed for roughly a month.

zh.s: 2020年伊利诺伊州民主党总统初选于3月17日、当月第三个初选星期二举行。该州是民主党为当年总统选举挑选候选人时，当天投票的三个州之一；俄亥俄州的投票则已推迟约一个月。

en.s: The 2020 Arizona Democratic presidential primary took place on March 17, 2020, the third primary Tuesday of the month, as one of three contests on the same day in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election, while the contest in Ohio had been postponed for roughly a month. The closed primary allocated 80 delegates towards the 2020 Democratic National Convention, of which 67 were pledged delegates allocated according to the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2020年亚利桑那州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年亚利桑那州民主党总统初选于3月17日、当月第三个初选星期二举行，是民主党为当年总统选举挑选候选人时，当天安排的三场竞选之一；俄亥俄州的投票则已推迟约一个月。此次封闭式初选共有80个民主党全国代表大会代表名额，其中67个须按初选结果分配，并支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2020 Florida Republican presidential primary took place on March 17, 2020, as one of the three contests scheduled on that date in the Republican Party presidential primaries for the 2020 presidential election.

zh.t: 2020年佛罗里达州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年佛罗里达州共和党总统初选于3月17日举行，是共和党为当年总统选举挑选候选人时，当天安排的三场提名竞选之一。

en.s: The election to elect the third vice president of Nepal was held on 17 March 2023. The term of the incumbent vice president, Nanda Kishor Pun, first elected in 2015, was set to expire on 17 March 2023. He was term-limited and could not seek re-election, with the Constitution of Nepal barring him from doing so.

zh.s: 尼泊尔于2023年3月17日举行选举，选出第三任副总统。2015年首次当选的现任副总统南达·基肖尔·普恩，任期于2023年3月17日届满。他已达到宪法规定的任期上限，不能再次竞选。

en.s: ONE Friday Fights 9: Eersel vs. Sinsamut 2 (also known as ONE Lumpinee 9) was a combat sports event produced by ONE Championship that took place on March 17, 2023, at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand.

en.s: The 2024 U-20 Copa Libertadores final (Spanish: Final de la Copa Libertadores Sub-20 de 2024) was the final of the 8th. edition of the U-20 Copa Libertadores, an under age football competition organised by CONMEBOL.
